sources: https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/StateForests/nhal/recreation/camping/modern ('Firefly Lake Campground, sites 201-271, is located in the central portion of the forest on the north side of the lake. All sites in the campground are reservable. This 27-acre lake has excellent swimming due to the clear water and fine sand beach. No boat motors are allowed. The campground has five vault toilet buildings, five hand pumps for drinking water, one flush toilet building with showers, separate trash and recycling dumpsters and a carry-in boat landing. This campground is only about one-half mile from the Crystal Lake Picnic Area and is accessible by the paved bike trail at the campground entrance'; 'Sites 202-203, 223-225, 226-227, 245-247 and 267-268 are double campsites'; 'This campground is open April 30 to Columbus Day'; 'Firefly Lake GPS coordinates: N46° 00.169', W89° 37.848''; modern campgrounds 'have paved roadways, flush toilets and showers but no electrical hookups'; 'Clear Lake and Crystal Lake campgrounds have dump stations'), read 2026-11-17

note: Modern campground in pine woods on the north shore of 27-acre Firefly Lake, a no-motors lake with clear water and a fine-sand swimming beach, reached by footpaths from the loops; carry-in boat landing. The paved Heart of Vilas County bike trail starts at the entrance; the nearest dump station is at Crystal Lake, about half a mile east. --Claude
summary: DNR modern-camping page + Firefly brochure (PUB-FR-745 2025) read; GoingToCamp refuses. 71 drive-in sites, no electric, showers/flush + vault + hand pumps, no dump (Crystal Lake's) confirmed; lakefront -> lakeview proposed (continuous pine canopy to the sand strip); PIN 1.2 km move proposed (stored point is in a bog west of the campground); website dead -> camping page; season manual (Columbus Day 2027 = Oct 11).
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview PROPOSED (no --AWH). The brochure map ('not drawn to scale') puts sites 259-263, 267-270 and 209-216 nearest the north shore, with green footpaths to the beach. On Esri (280 m half-width at 46.0012,-89.6335) and summer NAIP the whole north shore is continuous pine canopy right down to a narrow sand strip at the waterline; the campground roads are only faintly visible under the trees and no pad or clearing shows within about 50 m of the water. Lakefront is not earned; the lake-side rows support lakeview. Site photos are on GoingToCamp (refuses), so pads under the trees could not be checked. Same pattern and call as Crystal Lake (3302) in p3-507.

PIN (>250 m): stored 46.0030,-89.6483 -> 46.0018,-89.6330. The stored point is in an open bog about 1.2 km WEST of Firefly Lake. The lake is the round lake centred about 45.9990,-89.6338 (sand-rimmed north shore, about 0.5 mi west of Crystal Lake's west end); the DNR GPS N46 00.169 W89 37.848 (46.0028,-89.6308) is the northeast entrance and host area off County N. The new point is the middle of the loops about 110 m north of the shore (imagery estimate; the roads are under canopy).
